milestones.remaining: Pure host tests cover domain/policy contracts only. Controller, IPC, CLI, voice, installer, diagnostics and physical HIL remain open.

milestones.title: Deterministic controller core
milestones.remaining: Host validation covers pure deterministic controller semantics only: MANUAL, SEMI_AUTOMATIC, AUTOMATIC, DISABLED, dwell, hysteresis, median valid samples, staleness safe-off, recovery and policy-update stop behavior. No hardware adapter, daemon, IPC, CLI, voice, installer or physical Pi actuation is implemented yet.

milestones.title: Local environment service and IPC
milestones.remaining: Host validation covers bounded JSON protocol validation, host-fake service core, AF_UNIX server/client, socket mode, closed operation parameters, client error propagation and no hardware/shell imports. It does not implement production SHT31/libgpiod adapters, systemd unit installation, CLI command, voice action, dashboard, or real Pi actuation.

milestones.title: CLI, voice, installer, diagnostics and documentation integration
milestones.remaining: Ready after M10.5 IPC foundation. Next batch should integrate a safe env CLI surface and then diagnostics/installer/voice routes while continuing to use the single-owner service/client boundary.

milestones.remaining: Requires physical Pi, SHT31, relay, PENGLIN adapters, ELUTENG fan, audio and wake/latency evidence. Host tests cannot close this gate.
